steps.content: After confirming the absence of Hypercubes or survivors, Saina emerges from the ashes. In silence, she tosses the relics, scavenged from the monsters' maws, at the farlander' feet.
She knows that if she spares them the full, brutal truth, they will only return, lured back to their doom by the faintest glimmer of hope.

steps.speaker: Farlander A
steps.content: But we... we've already... we tried so hard...

steps.speaker: Farlander A
steps.content: Why... why is there ******* nothing?! Not a single damn Hypercube!!
The farlander's heart-wrenching wails are swallowed by the relentless wind. With a grim, practiced silence, the Aurum Secretum Warriors clean and sheathe their weapons.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: You can't fight. Your only purpose here is to become food for the monsters. If you want to live, get out of here. Now.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Let Fraser handle this. The Luminaris experts will be here soon. There's no need for you to throw your lives away.

steps.speaker: Farlander A
steps.content: ...Will they find anything? They've been searching for months. What have they ever found?

She has no reassurance to offer, and her silence is answer enough. The refugee's face crumbles. Despair curdles into fear, and finally, he sinks to the parched, rocky ground with a hollow, broken laugh.
A long silence stretches, broken only by the moan of the sand-laden wind. When he finally speaks, his voice is little more than a murmur.

steps.speaker: Farlander A
steps.content: Black Rings... Hypercubes... Do you think... the Disians... might know more about them...

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: <size=52>Shut your mouth about that ******* city!</size>
(Explodes with rage)

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: Who do you think caused all of this?! Who created the Black Ring and all these disasters?! Who's using Hypercubes to bleed us dry?! It's only been a few months; have you forgotten our warriors who died on the front lines?!

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: DisCity, <size=43>DisCity</size>, <size=52>DISCITY!! You're so fixated on them. Are you one of their damn spies?! </size><size=60>Should I just kill you now and save us the trouble?!</size>

steps.speaker: Farlander A
steps.content: Nngh!
She seizes the farlander by the collar, hauling him up. Her grip is iron, and the fury in her eyes promises violence.

steps.speaker: Saina
steps.content: If I ever hear that name from your mouth again, <size=60>I will kill you!!</size>
[Scene Change: Council Chamber]
In the council chamber, the meeting progresses into its latter half.

steps.speaker: II·Elliot Baker
steps.content: Neither DisCity nor Furor has discovered traces of the BR-005 mine, and we've already dispatched Aurum Secretum Warriors to search WhiteSands. However, this cannot be accomplished overnight. In the interim, we must employ other means to maintain our relationship with the Farland Alliance.

steps.speaker: II·Elliot Baker
steps.content: For instance, a grand event that rallies around our shared enemy... or perhaps a traitor who conspired with DisCity and leaked our critical secrets.

steps.speaker: II·Elliot Baker
steps.content: The most critical turning point in this war was not the collapse of supply lines, nor the DisCorps joining the conflict. It was during the final phase, when DisCity modified their anti-Mania devices to target the resonance properties of Aurum Secretum, which tore apart our defense line.

steps.speaker: II·Elliot Baker
steps.content: Such a strategy would be impossible to devise without a comprehensive understanding of Aurum Secretum. It must have been someone from Fraser... someone with intimate knowledge who leaked our secrets.

steps.speaker: II·Elliot Baker
steps.content: And we all know who this informant most likely is.
His eyes find the masked woman standing apart in the corner. Not a second is wasted; her response is with an immediate, practiced smile.

steps.speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Of course, esteemed sir. Thank you for raising this point.

steps.speaker: V·Lana Kantarella
steps.content: Rest assured, the traitor who sold out Aurum Secretum technology and Fraser's secrets—<color=#fb9259>Hypatia Campbell</color>—has already been taken into custody.
